map.在浏览器本地将 CSV 数据转换为 JSON 数组，支持自定义分隔符与表头。: Convert CSV data into a JSON array locally in the browser, with customizable delimiter and header handling.
map.CSV 转 JSON 按行拆分：首行为表头即字段名，其后每行按分隔符（默认英文逗: CSV to JSON splits row by row: if the first row is the header it supplies the field names, and every following row is split by the delimiter (an English comma by default, customizable) and paired column by column with the header to produce an array of "field: value" objects; a field containing the delimiter or a newline is wrapped in double quotes per RFC 4180, a double quote inside quotes is escaped as two double quotes, and the key-value pairs are emitted in row order.
map.首行为表头时，字段名取自第一行；否则使用 field_0、field_1 等默认: When the first row is the header, field names come from that row; otherwise the default keys field_0, field_1 and so on are used.
map.支持引号包裹的字段，引号内可包含分隔符和换行。: Quoted fields are supported, and quotes may contain delimiters and newlines.
map.空单元格将转换为空字符串，未填写的行会被忽略。: Empty cells become empty strings, and rows left unfilled are skipped.
map.接口联调：把后端导出的 CSV 结果快速转成: API debugging: quickly turn a CSV export from the backend into a
map.数组，直接粘贴进请求体或前端 mock，省去手写字段。: array that you can paste straight into a request body or a frontend mock, without hand-writing the fields.
map.表格迁移：Excel 或数据库导出的 CSV 需换成 JSON 以适配 NoSQ: Table migration: a CSV exported from Excel or a database often needs to become JSON to fit NoSQL storage or a multidimensional structure, and the conversion preserves the original rows and columns.
map.字段对齐：转换时指定表头映射与分隔符，避免中文逗号、半角引号导致的解析错位与字段: Field alignment: specify the header mapping and delimiter during conversion to avoid parse and field misalignment caused by Chinese commas and half-width quotes.
map.粘贴含「订单号,金额,状态」三列的 CSV，选择逗号分隔、首行作为表头；工具输出: Paste a CSV with the three columns "order number, amount, status", pick comma as the delimiter and use the first row as the header; the tool outputs [{"order number":"A1001","amount":"99.00","status":"paid"}], ready for API validation or frontend table rendering.
map.支持逗号、制表符、分号及自定义单字符；引号包裹字段内的分隔符不会被误拆，字段内容: Commas, tabs, semicolons and a custom single character are supported; delimiters inside quoted fields are not mis-split and the field content is preserved as is.
map.中文或特殊字符会乱码吗？: Will Chinese or special characters get garbled?
map.转换仅在本地进行，原样保留 UTF-8 字符；导出后建议以 UTF-8 保存，避: The conversion runs locally and preserves UTF-8 characters as is; after exporting, save as UTF-8 to avoid encoding problems when reopening the file.
map.结果能直接当接口数据用吗？: Can the result be used as API data directly?
map.仅做格式转换、不校验业务合法性；金额、日期等类型仍按字符串保留，接入前请按需做类: It only converts the format and does not validate business rules; amounts, dates and other types are still kept as strings, so validate types and ranges as needed before integrating.
